description: React component for a Weekly Report editor page with auto-save drafts and submit/publish functionality, interacting with a Supabase backend to store weekly report data.

methods.name: startOfWeek
methods.description: Calculates the start of the week (Monday) for a given date.

methods.name: toISODate
methods.description: Converts a date to ISO string format (YYYY-MM-DD).

methods.name: emptySections
methods.description: Returns an object with empty string fields for report sections.

methods.name: loadExistingDraft
methods.description: Loads an existing weekly report draft from the database for a given week.
